scope: Training-bank CTC alignment-spike retention after the existing trailing-30ms averaging. No speech labels or waveform changes.
collapse_rule: Collapse consecutive identical argmax IDs before removing blank ID zero.
limits: These are model-coordinate predictions after averaging, not ground-truth phone strings. A future sequence-level CTC experiment must regenerate and retain the original fine-resolution teacher output; do not manufacture transcripts from this sparse bank.
